---
title: "Feature: Advanced scenario authoring and validation studio"
labels: "enhancement,roadmap,priority:P2,area:training"
---

## Problem

The current custom-scenario form captures the core diagnosis and remediation but
does not expose the complete built-in scenario structure.

## Proposed improvement

Add an advanced authoring studio for symptoms, objectives, commands, outputs,
hints, difficulty, topology focus, and case-study content.

## Acceptance criteria

- Support simple and advanced authoring modes.
- Add, reorder, edit, and remove command/output pairs and hints.
- Preview the scenario exactly as a learner will see it.
- Validate completeness and unsafe markup before saving.
- Duplicate a built-in scenario into an editable custom copy.
- Export authored content through the scenario-pack format.
- Preserve drafts locally after accidental navigation.
- Add documentation with one complete authored example.
